target_customer: Young consumers in India who want to socialize online under pseudonymous avatars
problem: People hold back on mainstream social networks tied to real identity; the company bet on avatar-based pseudonymous interaction.
business_model: Consumer social app; revenue model not documented in found sources

founders.name: Jhansi Elango
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no background given.

founders.name: Vivek Nautiyal
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no background given.

exit.reason: Cause not public. YC lists the company as Inactive.

competitors.name: Zepeto
competitors.what: South Korean avatar app with social interaction through avatars

competitors.name: Facebook Avatars
competitors.what: Bitmoji-style avatar stickers launched in India

technical_complexity.rationale: A consumer social app with avatar creation and moderation; modest engineering but a hard cold start.

defensibility.rationale: No network yet; avatar features were being copied by Facebook, Snapchat and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Facebook launched Avatars in India in June 2020. No acquisition of Chutney found.

market_need_then: Not documented in found sources; avatars were mainstream by 2020 through Zepeto, Bitmoji and Facebook.

branding.domain_note: The directory mentions chutneystore.com as a former site per a search summary; not verified.

identity.mascot_or_character: Avatars as user identities, per the YC description

brand_strength.rationale: A branding search found no press about this app; results were other companies and foods named Chutney.

outcome_analysis: Chutney Inc was a five person Bengaluru team in YC Winter 2020 building a pseudonymous avatar social network. YC lists it Inactive but no article, post or founder statement explains why, so the cause is not public. Failure factors are left empty.
notes: No company website is listed, so no site was fetched; treated as dead or unknown. The seed rests on CB Insights (150K, March 17 2020); Dealroom lists 125K seed, a conflict; both look like the YC deal and single databases. CB Insights also shows a later AI customer research company called Chutney founded in 2019, which may be unrelated or a pivot; no source links them so it is not recorded as a pivot. Facebook Avatars source is dated June 2020, after the early 2020 batch. Zepeto source is a personal blog from 2018 and the 150M users figure comes from an IPS News/TechCrunch listing, not the blog.
